Definition: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
BiblicalUsage: 1) sun; 1a) sun; 1b) sunrise, sun-rising, east, sun-setting, west (of direction); 1c) sun (as object of illicit worship); 1d) openly, publicly (in other phrases); 1e) pinnacles, battlements, shields (as glittering or shining)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
